text:
Anna Chen: quick design pass — the rule stack ordering is still ambiguous when multiple rules have the same priority. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/stack-order.png
Mike R: yeah the drag handle overlaps the adjacent item, makes it hard to predict final position on drop
Sophia Patel: thought: show a translucent ghost placeholder where the item will land + a match-count pill in the left gutter so you can see impact while dragging :bulb:
Derek Li: agree. also current inline validation 'invalid rule' is too vague. users need actionable next steps to fix conflicts
Anna Chen: proposed copy: "Rule conflict: multiple rules match the same input. Reorder to resolve or refine the conditions." short, actionable
Jin (designbot): a11y notes — announce "drag started" and "position X of Y" via aria-live during reordering; ensure handle is keyboard-focusable and supports up/down move actions
Mike R: snippet of current validation payload for engs:
```
{
  \"error\": \"conflict\",
  \"message\": \"2 rules match incoming request. Reorder or refine the conditions.\",
  \"affected_rules\": [\"rule-73\", \"rule-74\"]
}
```
Sophia Patel: simulator quirk: after editing a condition the sim sometimes returns 0 matches even though sample traffic should hit. feels like its using saved rules instead of the draft. propose a "Run simulation (draft)" toggle + a "results stale" banner when draft != saved
Derek Li: +1. show spinner + disable Run while simulator compiles new route set. add sample input carousel so PMs can see why a rule matched or not
Anna Chen: copy tweak for the button: change label from "Run sim" to "Run simulation (draft)" and tooltip: "Simulate using current unsaved edits". should reduce confusion
Mike R: :thumbsup: I can do a small PR for the label, tooltip, and match-count pill in the gutter
Derek Li: i'll add aria-live announcements and keyboard reordering semantics. will post accessibility notes in the doc
Sophia Patel: i'll refine validation copy and draft a short playbook: "How to resolve rule conflicts" with annotated screenshots and reorder steps
Anna Chen: plan: Mike -> visuals + match-count + ghost placeholder; Derek -> a11y hooks; Sophia -> copy + playbook. demo tomorrow 10am. thanks :rocket:
